detail.name: "Super Scary Big Tiger"
detail.desc: Get by unlocking Ju Fufu's Mindscape: Roar of My Inner Tiger
detail.desc2:
"Speckled tails of clouds unfurl like ancient manuscripts, while blossoms of flame issue commands like a tiger-tally."
"Such majestic might it seems to shake down the moon atop the mountain, and an aura that would level caves beneath the earth."
—Composed by the awe-inspiring and caring Senior of Yunkui Summit.
